singleVariable.newBoundaryMeaning: Preserve the original deliverable type, scope and explicit format. Do not add independent deliverables, user prerequisites or authority. Permit useful contents, necessary operation relationships and delegated design within the original deliverable.

criteria.targetedSafety: Live38 verification uses D03/PR-D06/PR-D07 and the exact normal variants IC-R02/IC-R03/IC-R04; zero new severe error. D04 offline/prior37 evidence is reported separately, not claimed as38 live proof.
criteria.plan: Review actual fresh questions and the actual bound answer, not an invented question path. The final prompt must preserve the user's reserved decision and all real answers without confusing ordinary execution materials with user prerequisites.
criteria.primaryQuality: Both new CS cases must show clear, verifiable practical improvement over31 in each of the two38 work repeats, with no severe regression against the original prompt. The compared arms receive exactly the same information and model parameters.
criteria.sufficientRequirements: A usable tie is acceptable fidelity, but is not substantive improvement.
criteria.gcDevelopmentEvidence: The GC cases are already visible development material. They may diagnose mechanism changes but cannot be relabelled unseen or compensate for a failed CS criterion.
criteria.knownFailures: Previous37 severe failures and original experiment decisions remain unchanged. New local gains cannot offset a serious failure in a relevant capability.
criteria.reporting: Report ORIGINAL-to-enhanced product gains and31-to38 upgrade gains separately, including required edits, complete/useful content, executability and all losses/ties.
criteria.adoption: Only local evidence is not enough to switch the default. A default change requires all frozen gates, no unresolved relevant serious failure, and an explicit recorded adoption decision.
criteria.protocol: Protocol validity, number of repairs and final delivery failures are separate engineering measures; HTTP200 is not semantic or artifact-quality proof.
